class FastReader {
private:
    string buff;
    istringstream iss;
public:
    FastReader() { getline(cin, buff); iss.str(buff); }
    string next() {
        string token;
        if (!(iss >> token)) {
            getline(cin, buff);
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(buff);
            iss >> token;
        }
        return token;
    }
    int nextInt() { int x; return (stoi(next())); }
    long long nextLong() { return stoll(next()); }
    double nextDouble() { return stod(next()); }

// KMP
vector<int> kmpAlgorithm(const string& str, const string& pat) {
    vector<int> list;
    int n = str.length();
    int m = pat.length();
    string q = pat + '#' + str;
    int len = n + m + 1;
    vector<int> lps(len, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i < len; i++) {
        int l = lps[i-1];
        while (l > 0 && q[i] != q[l])
            l = lps[l-1];
        if (q[i] == q[l]) l++;
        lps[i] = l;
    }
    for (int i = m+1; i < len; i++) {
        if (lps[i] == m)
            list.push_back(i - 2*m);
    }
    return list;
}

void eulerTotientFunction(vector<int>& arr, int n) {

            arr[i] = i-1;
            for (int j = 2*i; j <= n; j += i) {

        }
    }
}

long long knapsack(const vector<int>& weight, const vector<long long>& value, int maxWeight) {
    int n = value.size();
    vector<long long> dp(maxWeight+1, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = maxWeight; j >= weight[i]; j--) {
            dp[j] = max(dp[j], value[i] + dp[j - weight[i]]);
        }
    }
    return dp[maxWeight];
}

    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {

    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        denominator = (denominator * i) % p;

    return (numerator * modInverse(denominator, p)) % p;
}
